name: khr-meshopt-conformance
perspective: near-front view of the complete labeled cube grid
description: Verify CesiumJS 1.143's automatic KHR_meshopt_compression decoding with the official tagged conformance asset, including the v1 attribute codec and COLOR filter cases, without application-side decoder wiring.
prompt: Create a no-token Viewer with baseLayer: false, globe: false, skyBox: false, skyAtmosphere: false, navigationHelpButton: false, and a dark background. Load https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CesiumGS/cesium/1.143/Specs/Data/Models/glTF-2.0/MeshoptCubeTest/glTF-Meshopt/MeshoptCubeTest.gltf directly with await Cesium.Model.fromGltfAsync. Do not import, configure, or call a meshopt decoder or private loader helper. Anchor the model at Cartesian3.fromDegrees(-75.0, 40.0, 1000) with Transforms.eastNorthUpToFixedFrame and set scale: 100. Add it to viewer.scene.primitives, then wait for model.readyEvent if model.ready is still false before reading model.boundingSphere. Because the grid is an offset vertical board, frame the complete asset with viewer.camera.viewBoundingSphere using a HeadingPitchRange of about -90 degrees heading, -10 degrees pitch, and range 0 so Cesium computes a viewport-safe near-front view; do not target the raw anchor. The official asset and its relative binary resources must remain on the immutable 1.143 tag URL.
expected_behaviors: Creates a Viewer that does not require ion imagery or terrain
Calls Model.fromGltfAsync with the official Cesium 1.143 MeshoptCubeTest glTF URL
Relies on CesiumJS automatic KHR_meshopt_compression decoding
Does not import or wire a meshopt decoder or private loader helper
Anchors the model with Transforms.eastNorthUpToFixedFrame and adds it to scene.primitives
Waits for model.readyEvent before reading the bounding sphere when necessary
Uses the model bounding sphere and a near-front camera angle that keeps the entire labeled grid visible
Loads all conformance rows, including attribute codec and COLOR filter cases, without runtime errors
visual_expectations: A dark-background near-front view of the complete labeled conformance grid: five columns by five rows of decoded cubes plus readable row and column labels, with no missing or corrupted geometry.

programmatic_checks.description: No JS or model loader errors
Uses the public async Model loader
Uses the immutable official 1.143 conformance asset
Adds the model to the scene
Waits for render readiness before reading model bounds
Frames the model's computed bounds rather than its offset origin
Avoids private or application-side decoder wiring

screenshots.description: Complete decoded KHR meshopt conformance grid
